summary: Independent review B rejects Candidate E v1. The image is neutral and free of discrete artifacts, but south-east amplitude is roughly half the required level and the right side reads as cloudy repeated blobs. No candidate was published.
required_changes: Double only the south-east deviations around the current median so Q90-Q10 reaches about 34-38 levels; keep north-east, geometry, 160-320 px scale, and 64-80 px transitions unchanged.
